title: Rerack Protocol for Opentrons
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, fill in any required protocol parameters as prompted before proceeding.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip it on your computer if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware JSON files
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any .json labware files required for this run.

steps.title: Upload protocol Python file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons app, upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck with tip racks
steps.instruction: Place the deck items according to the deck map: four 200 µL filter tipracks (only rows A and B occupied) and the destination rack that will receive the consolidated tips. Ensure the P300 multi‑channel pipette is set to use offset tip pickups.

substeps.instruction: Place four 200 µL filter tipracks on the designated slots.
Load tips only in rows A and B of each rack.
Place the empty rack that will receive the consolidated tips in its slot.
Confirm the P300 multi‑channel pipette is selected and configured for offset tip pickups.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons app to calibrate the tipracks, destination rack, and the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate the P300 multi‑channel pipette tip offset if prompted.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the Opentrons app to start the tip‑reracking consolidation protocol.
